Subject: Request: private deployment architecture review (VPC / air-gapped)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Crestline is moving toward a private deployment for a clinical inference workflow and we need a focused architecture review to validate our constraints:

- Air-gapped option with periodic data ingest via removable media
- VPC-only access for clinical systems; strict egress controls
- HSM/KMS integration for patient-data keys
- Patch/update process in a disconnected environment

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive next week to cover network requirements, firewall/IP ranges, offline key exchange, and an ops playbook for upgrades? We’d like to include our infrastructure lead (Tom) and the vendor who will handle hardware installs (NetSecure).

Preferred window: Oct 18–22, mornings (PST). Procurement timeline: PO by end of Nov. Please advise what prep materials you need.

Thanks,
Jordan

Adding a few technical notes ahead of the session so we can use the time efficiently.

- Please confirm whether the air-gap is full (no outbound internet) or limited via a controlled bastion for patching. That affects our recommended update cadence and tooling.
- For HSM: do you plan to use on-prem HSM (e.g., Thales/PKCS#11) or a managed HSM appliance? We support both patterns but need vendor docs for integration testing.
- IP/Firewall: we’ll need a short list of IPs that the Redwood runtime should be allowed to reach during initial setup or for periodic telemetry (if any) — if truly air-gapped, we can run without telemetry but will need offline metrics extraction instructions.
- Offline ingest: typical patterns we recommend: signed manifests for media, checksum verification, and a controlled import host that performs validation. We can provide scripts if you want.

Attachment: redwood-vpc-onprem-playbook-v1.docx (contains checklist, recommended ports, and upgrade gating policy)

Suggested meeting duration: 75 minutes to leave time for outstanding Qs. If Oct 19 09:00 PST works for you, I’ll tentatively hold that block on our side.

— Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
